summary: Explains that collections can carry GnuPG signatures on Pulp 3 Galaxy and shows manually creating a detached signature of MANIFEST.json from the built tarball using gpg.
questions: How do I sign my collection with GPG?
What file in the collection tarball gets signed?

answer_card.title: Sign a collection manually
answer_card.answer_md:
Pulp 3 Galaxy supports GnuPG signatures. With an existing private key:
```bash
ansible-galaxy collection build
tar -Oxzf namespace-name-1.0.0.tar.gz MANIFEST.json | gpg --output namespace-name-1.0.0.asc --detach-sign --armor --local-user email@example.com -
```
The detached signature covers `MANIFEST.json`.
